topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: It seems the neighbor has a grand idea, a fence, you see. I walked through the yard, the grass whispering secrets underfoot, when I noticed the outline of a fence appearing like a cloud on the horizon. Wood planks began to sprout, like trees that grow overnight but in orderly lines. The neighbor, a whirlwind of intentions, found me in this surreal yard, where the sky dipped a little too close to the ground. They spoke of boundaries and privacy, concepts that felt suddenly as fluid as the air. I listened, watching the fence weave itself into the fabric of the day, wondering how it had not been there all along.
